roadmap.goal: Apply one project-name rule (trim, then empty, then no control character from the shared D3 set, then at most 256 Unicode scalars, then unique within the team by case-insensitive name or non-empty derived slug) with one copy source at both user doors (team-member create, instance-admin rename), so every refusal states the same reason, leaves nothing behind and never becomes a 500, and give every new project a non-empty, team-unique slug (the lower-cased key prefix with the lowest free -N suffix when the name derives none).
roadmap.scenario_ownership_invariant: All 31 DISTILL acceptance scenarios (74 outline rows) are owned by exactly one step (01-01: 0 acceptance + 13 core unit tests; 01-02: 8 + 5 check-arch gold tests; 02-01: 6 + 1 core + 1 services + 2 check-arch gold tests; 02-02: 3; 03-01: 4 + 4 core; 04-01: 8 + 5 core + 5 services; 05-01: 2). Scaffold totals: 23 core (crates/foundry-core/tests/project_name.rs), 6 services (crates/foundry-services/tests/create_project_use_case.rs), 7 check-arch gold tests (xtask/src/check_arch.rs mod project_name_one_source_tests). DELIVER un-pends a scenario and un-ignores a scaffold only in the step that owns it, in the DISTILL order. Scenario 20 sits in the US-PNR-03 Rule block but is owned by 02-01 (it turns GREEN when the cap reaches create). Scenario 21 is expected to stay RED until 03-01: 01-01 ports collides_with_sibling verbatim (no empty-slug skip) and 03-01 adds the skip. The two parity outlines (22, 23) are deliberately moved from DISTILL's slice-03 position to the final step 05-01: the ZWJ-family create row derives a non-empty slug but the matrix is only meaningful once every create-side change (rule, uniqueness, mint) has landed; they stay @pending until 05-01 even if they pass earlier. Burn-down: grep -cE '^[[:space:]]*@.*@pending' crates/foundry-acceptance/tests/features/project-name-rule.feature (31 now, 0 at 05-01), grep -n 'SCAFFOLD' crates/foundry-core/tests/project_name.rs crates/foundry-services/tests/create_project_use_case.rs, and grep -n 'SCAFFOLD' xtask/src/check_arch.rs restricted to the project_name_one_source section.
